# Bid the height and the drain, not the linear foot.

> Price a retaining wall from face area, drain-stone volume, geogrid layers, corners, and the engineer/permit step a per-linear-foot quote hides — then see price per foot, crew hours, and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
